details:
Q1: What scope should the "bounded automated reporter" have?
Choices:
A) A recurring, bounded backfill pass wired into an existing scheduled workflow (for example the `*/30` `review_autofix_sweep.yml` tick). It finds failed review/autofix runs on open PRs that the intake never handled and sends each one, once, through the existing `autofix_failure` report path to the trusted intake. It ships on, with a `false` off switch. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A one-time catch-up limited to the specific historical failure behind #7059/PR #7065. It still runs automatically, but needs a `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry under §20.F.
C) No code change. Record that a `sandbox_path_unsupported` failure is non-retryable by design (#6756) and correctly gets only a PR diagnosis plus `ai:needs-human`, so this activation gap is closed as "working as intended".
   **Note:** if you pick C, Q2 and Q3 no longer apply; answer them with A.
Q2: When a reported failure has reason `conflict_resolver_sandbox_path_unsupported`, what should the intake produce?
Choices:
A) Keep today's #6756 route: one `ai:workflow-heal-non-retryable:v1` diagnosis comment on the PR, `ai:needs-human`, and a WARNING, with no heal issue. That diagnosis is the "successor". (RECOMMENDED)
B) Add a narrow routing exception for backfilled reports only. If provenance verification passes (trusted marker author, verified run, matching head), file an `ai:workflow-heal` issue. It still goes through the pre-filing scope-marker check, and the resolver's fail-closed path policy stays unchanged.
C) File a heal issue for every `sandbox_path_unsupported` report, live or backfilled. This removes that reason from the non-retryable routing.
Q3: How should the reporter identify the "historical failed run" it must verify and dispatch?
Choices:
A) Only from trusted markers. Use the newest `review-autofix-failure:v1` marker written by the `GH_PAT` account on an open PR's current head, with a `NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS` reason and no matching `ai:workflow-heal-non-retryable:v1` diagnosis for that pr/head/reason. Then check the run against the existing provenance gate (repository, failed status, workflow path, PR link). (RECOMMENDED)
B) Any failed `review_autofix.yml` run on an open PR within a fixed lookback window, whether or not a trusted failure marker exists.
C) Only an explicit list of run IDs taken from issue #7059's evidence. Please give the run ID(s), because the repository doesn't record them.
